The '''Ord Varee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Belshar sector/Legends|Belshar sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Varee]].
